ai_translate.description: SubDL translates one of its existing subtitles into a language nobody has uploaded, using your monthly translation quota, and publishes the result on subdl.com as a regular subtitle.
ai_translate.title: AI-translate missing languages (needs SubDL Plus or Pro; SubDL publishes each translation as a regular subtitle)

ai_translate_timeout_seconds.description: How long a download waits for SubDL to finish a translation.
ai_translate_timeout_seconds.title: AI translation wait in seconds

anime_mode.description: Enable extra absolute-episode, season-only, and title-only searches for anime libraries.
anime_mode.title: Anime mode

api_key.description: SubDL API key from your SubDL account.
api_key.title: API key

include_ai_translated.description: Show subtitles SubDL has already AI-translated.
include_ai_translated.title: Include AI-translated subtitles (always on while AI-translate is on)

request_delay_ms.description: Optional politeness delay between SubDL API calls.
request_delay_ms.title: Delay between requests (ms)

description: Uses the official SubDL API for movie and episode subtitles, including season packs, optional anime search fallbacks, and opt-in AI translation for Plus or Pro accounts.
